text: Android: one invalid field wedges sync forever, and sync failures are invisible
relates: T-28/T-31 for the 401 handling path only; the validation wedge itself is independent.

Quarantine (part 3) needs a NEW sync-state column: dirty:Boolean is the only
sync bit on ItemEntity/ListEntity, so "clear dirty to stop pushing the bad row"
silently discards the user's edit. Add a separate flag (e.g. syncBlocked) so
dirtyRows() skips it while the row stays visible/editable — a Room schema
change, but a destructive migration is fine here since all local data is
re-syncable (SyncEngine already does full wipe+resync on 410). Scoping for part
(1): of the fields the server 422-validates (status enum, decimal amount,
name-non-empty), the client already enforces name-non-empty and status is
UI-constrained — price amount + currency are the only user-typed fields with no
client validation, so input validation alone closes the practical wedge; the
row-id-in-422 + client quarantine is true defense-in-depth for the general case.

Scoping (impl): splitting part 2 (sync-health visibility surface) into its own ticket T-47 — it's the separable 'failures are invisible' half. T-32 now = the reliability fix: part 1 (client price validation/normalization, the only user-typed fields the server 422-validates) + part 3 (server row_id/field in 422 [done, f5c70eb] + client syncBlocked quarantine so one bad row can't wedge the queue). T-32 keeps the syncBlocked column that T-47 will surface.

Done: server 422 enrichment (f5c70eb) + Android reliability fix (9ca893a).
Verified: full server suite (139) + Android debug unit suite + lintDebug green.

Scope delivered = the "wedges forever" half:
- Part 1: client price validation/normalization (the only user-typed 422-able
  fields) — a bad value gets an inline error and never reaches the DB/sync.
- Part 3: server names row_id+field in the 422; client quarantines that row
  (new items.syncBlocked column, Room v2 ALTER migration), retries the rest,
  auto-clears the block on re-edit.

Part 2 (sync-health visibility surface — "failures are invisible") carved out
to T-47; the syncBlocked flag + blockedRowCount() are in place for it to show.

Note the AddItemDialogTest flake seen during verification is pre-existing
Compose-timing flakiness (passes in isolation), unrelated to this change —
logged on T-29 with a suggested waitUntil fix.
